note: Decisions fixed BEFORE any evaluation run that uses them. Sweeps are labelled sensitivity (not selection). The revalidation config at results/revalidation/config_frozen.json is inherited; this file adds the decisions specific to the final report.

primary_metric.name: per_window_macro_f1
primary_metric.definition: mean over evaluation windows of each window's macro-F1, then mean over seeds
primary_metric.secondary: pooled_macro_f1 = macro-F1 of y_true/y_pred concatenated over all evaluation windows of a run
primary_metric.reason: the paper's primary table (Table II / 9A table9a_main.csv) reports the per-window mean; the revalidation reproduces it to <1e-9 (T1_crosscheck.csv). Pooled is reported as a sensitivity column because the two aggregations diverge sharply on UGR'16 (up to 0.199 for Full Retraining); all headline claims use the per-window mean so they match the paper.

statistics.seed_test: paired exact Wilcoxon signed-rank, n=5 seeds; min attainable two-sided p = 0.0625
statistics.bootstrap: block bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 0; day blocks for UGR'16 (24), regime visits otherwise
statistics.holm_family: RAPT-Cheap vs Full Retraining on Campus across the ladder configurations evaluated

hypothesis_decision_rule.rule: A hypothesis is SUPPORTED only if the block-bootstrap 95% CI of the relevant paired difference excludes zero in the predicted direction; otherwise NOT SUPPORTED if the point estimate is in the opposite direction, or INCONCLUSIVE if the CI spans zero with the point estimate in the predicted direction.
hypothesis_decision_rule.H1: label semantics drift per regime across visits; predicted direction: same-regime-visit transfer worse than contiguous-block transfer
hypothesis_decision_rule.H2: checkpoints trained on the wrong regime's data (provenance bug) and never refreshed; predicted direction: provenance-fixed RAPT better than base RAPT
hypothesis_decision_rule.H3: attack non-stationarity in time hurts any old model; predicted direction: Frozen and RAPT degrade as the stream moves away from the prefix

cost_measurement.source: Step 8 only; earlier cost numbers are superseded
